class.name: OVSimulation
class.description: The [OVSimulation] singleton allows you to query and modify the simulation's global run-time parameters. It also stores information about the current build of the OpenVic-Simulation library, such as the current version.

method.name: get_author_info
method.description: Returns the simulation author information as a [Dictionary], where each entry is an [Array] of strings with the names of notable contributors to the OpenVic Simulation Library: [code]senior_developers[/code], [code]developers[/code], [code]contributors[/code], and [code]consultants[/code].

method.name: get_copyright_info
get_license_info
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] of licenses used by OpenVic-Simulation and included third party components. Each entry is a license name (such as "[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MIT_License#Ambiguity_and_variants]MIT[/url]") and its associated text.

method.name: get_license_text
method.description: Returns the full OpenVic-Simulation license text.

method.name: get_version_info
